items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I got in touch with Sandra, and I met her -- that was the first time I had seen her since she was 3 months old

ctx.x: Sandra was 29 at that time -- she had six daughters of her own, and was living in the Bronx, in New York. I said, 'Well, is there any way I can get in touch with her?' and she said, 'Yes', because one thing about Clara, Clara was always a nice person -- she was very nice about it; she said, 'Well, this is something that happened between us and didn't hold it against me', so when I came to New York, I got in touch with Sandra, and I met her -- that was the first time I had seen her since she was 3 months old; she…
I mean, that was part of my love life.
